name: agent-suite-persona-rationale
body: source: the brief says "reuse or add a user/stakeholder as appropriate" and points at existing users `requirements.user.navigator-agent` and `requirements.user.code-writer-agent`. Verification: neither existing user covers this change-set's interest — the navigator-agent's body is about the task cadence under the branch graph's staleness guard, and the code-writer-agent's is about filesystem grants. The existing stakeholders are likewise about source decomposition (`source-maintainer`), frontend toolchains (`frontend-maintainer`), the edge vocabulary (`spec-author`), and checkout-independent graphs (`multi-user-repo-team`); none owns the distributed-versus-generated agent-roster boundary. Resolution: add `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer` (the distribution boundary) and `requirements.user.apg-upgrader` (the person who must manually remove a now-duplicated local reviewer after `apg init`). [autonomous]
